geometry: Original named mesh components, smooth swept variable-radius bodies, rounded cast panels, hand-positioned anatomy and per-character articulated local joints. One editable .blend per semantic character.
units: Metres. Blender Z-up, local -Y front, stationary ground-centred asset root. glTF Y-up and +Z front. Each character uses one fixed physical scale.
sourceLighting: Cycles 12 samples, denoising, Standard view, neutral sky, warm key and cool fill/rim. Square 480 px inspection renders. Native view directions use the actual stored source cameras.
animation: 24 fps. Named NLA tracks per articulated object. Idle loops and reaction one-shots for all eight. CH19/20/22 have two-second ability clips with frame 24 contact. Clip output carries presentation only.
export: Apply bevels/normals to the in-memory reopened scene and join static components per rigid parent while preserving separate native source pieces. Selected hierarchy only, GLB with embedded PBR factors, Y up, exported extras, no texture coordinates or tangents needed, no textures, no cameras/lights. Baked and optimized NLA_TRACKS at 24 fps.
review: Independent Blender reimport; Firefox 159 through Playwright and Three.js, sRGB/no tone mapping, isolated loopback TLS. The viewer compares world joint matrices and exact transformed vertex bounds at 0/25/50/75/100 percent of each clip.
placement: Frozen resident and party coordinates come from assets-src/rooms/scene-layouts.json. Exported assets have zero runtime usage entries pending room integration.
